opening.argument: The poster presents Forsage as “NETWORK MARKETING” offering “LIFE TIME INCOME,” displays a contact number, and assures viewers “No Scams Risks.” The title reinforces that pitch with “Lifetime Income with Mobile,” while the description promotes Forsage earning alongside account setup and registration. These are direct promotional signals, not reporting or critical examination of the offer. The speaker further frames making money through it as a path to happiness, saying, “So with this money i can have happiness among the people.” Taken together, the lifetime-income claim, categorical reassurance, contact prompt, and earning and registration promotion establish a recruitment-oriented offer built around income claims.
